goal_details.response: Member MEM-104 is currently receiving an active disability pension (Kuntoutustuki). Under statutory rules (OVE-POL-02), OVE cannot be granted concurrently with a full disability pension.

story: Member MEM-104 wants to apply for 50% OVE while receiving a disability pension.
